_schema._purpose: Release feed for TRACE's in-app update check. The app fetches this file, compares versionCode with the running build, and offers the download when this file is newer.
_schema._where_it_lives: Commit this file to the repository root and serve it raw, e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<user>/<repo>/main/updates.json . Then set Trace.updateFeedUrl in gradle.properties to that URL.
_schema._generated_by: scripts/make_update_feed.ps1 - run it on each release instead of editing by hand.

_fields.versionCode: int, required. Must be strictly greater than the installed build's versionCode (Trace.versionCode in gradle.properties) for the update to be offered.
_fields.versionName: string, required. Shown in the dialog title, e.g. "2.4.0".
_fields.downloadUrl: string, required. Direct link to the .apk. For GitHub Releases this is https://github.com/<user>/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<file>.apk . Aliases accepted: url, apk.
_fields.releaseNotes: string[] or a single newline-separated string. One bullet per new feature or fix, shown in the dialog and the notification. Aliases accepted: changelog, notes.
_fields.mandatory: bool, optional, default false. When true the dialog cannot be dismissed and Skip/Later are hidden.
_fields._ignored: Any key starting with an underscore is documentation and is ignored by the parser.

_schema._signing: CRITICAL: the APK at downloadUrl must be signed with the same keystore as the installed app (Trace.release.storeFile). Android refuses an update signed with a different key, and the user would have to uninstall first, losing their playlists and likes.

_release._note: Informational only - TRACE's parser ignores underscore-prefixed keys.
